decisions.reason: As a close-to-core add-on for machine-tool fluid management, it likely has modest carrying costs and strategic upside, so without clear negative market evidence management would keep the option open despite somewhat higher adjacency risk than the filters.

This coolant filter builds directly on the firm’s established filtration know-how and customer base, so in a growing and investing business it is a low-cost, high-fit option that management would usually retain unless sales were clearly poor.

The gravity band coolant filter is also very close to the core offer and can likely be supported through existing engineering, production and service structures, making it worth keeping on the market while demand across customer applications continues to develop.
